value.name: Micky asks Jimmy to reach Kasie
value.description: Micky tells Jimmy he cannot speak to Kasie himself and asks Jimmy to help him get through to her.
evidence: MICKY I'm asking YOU, Jimmy. I can't talk to her, so I'm asking YOU.

value.name: Kasie greets her father at the door
value.description: Kasie comes to the doorway and hugs Micky hello when Jimmy calls her over.
evidence: JIMMY Kasie, talk to your father.
Micky's daughter, KASIE WARD, 10, curly hair, cute, comes up to the door, hugs her father hello.

value.name: Laurie objects to the visit
value.description: Laurie angrily protests the situation and tells Jimmy not to involve her in the exchange.
evidence: JIMMY Don't put me in the middle-a this.

value.name: Kasie mentions Micky's upcoming fight
value.description: Through the doorway, Kasie acknowledges that Micky has a fight coming up against Saoul Mamby.
evidence: KASIE (through the doorway) Daddy's gotta fight Saoul Mamby-

value.name: Micky promises a better future
value.description: Micky tells Kasie that after he wins the fight he will start making good money and move to a bigger apartment so she can stay with him more often.
evidence: MICKY That's right, and I wanna tell ya that after I win --
MICKY I'm gonna staht makin' good money.
MICKY I'll move to a biggah apahtment so you can live with me more days like we talked about.

value.name: Laurie dismisses Micky's promise
value.description: Laurie rejects Micky's claims as unrealistic and accuses him of misleading Kasie.
evidence: LAURIE Hah! That's a good one!
LAURIE Don't hold ya breath, Kasie. It's cruel to mislead ya child, Micky.

value.name: Laurie shuts the door on Micky
value.description: Laurie closes the door, ending the face-to-face exchange and continuing to argue inside with Jimmy.
evidence: She closes the door, arguing inside with Jimmy.

value.name: Kasie wishes Micky luck
value.description: After the door closes, Kasie calls out through it to wish her father good luck.
evidence: KASIE (shouts through door) Good luck, Daddy!

value.name: Micky thanks Kasie through the door
value.description: Micky responds to Kasie's farewell by shouting his thanks back through the closed door.
